sla.description: Targets count business hours only; they pause while waiting on the customer.

sla.creating: Creating: fill in the code, then save
sla.label: Display name
sla.holidaysHint: Whole days listed here never count towards targets, even when they are workdays.
sla.hint: Changes apply to new or reopened tickets; existing due times are not recalculated.
